title: The Joomla import reads System Information's PHP version with the session's form token
steps: Run the import-gates case for #225: phpinfo disabled, no X-Powered-By; the fake Joomla answers the System Information export only with the form token from the page's own JSON link.
expect: php_too_old with php 7.3.33 and minimumPhp 7.4, check below_minimum, and no install POST.
evidence: Issue #225 re-test: view=sysinfo&format=json answered 303 on Joomla 3.10 without a token
